questions.question: What does 'पाणी' (Paani) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'पाणी' means water in Marathi. It is one of the most common everyday words.

questions.question: What does 'आई' (Aai) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'आई' means Mother in Marathi. It is the most affectionate term for mother in Maharashtra.

questions.question: What does 'बाबा' (Baba) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'बाबा' means Father in Marathi. It is widely used across Maharashtra.

questions.question: What does 'शाळा' (Shaala) mean?
questions.explanation: 'शाळा' means school in Marathi. Children go to शाळा every day.

questions.question: How do you say 'one' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'एक' means one in Marathi. Numbers: एक (1), दोन (2), तीन (3), चार (4), पाच (5).

questions.question: What does 'घर' (Ghar) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'घर' means house/home in Marathi. This word is common across many Indian languages.

questions.question: What does 'हो' (Ho) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'हो' means Yes in Marathi. The informal version is also used widely in conversation.

questions.question: What does 'पुस्तक' (Pustak) mean?
questions.explanation: 'पुस्तक' means book in Marathi (and Hindi). It comes from the Sanskrit 'पुस्तकम्'.

questions.question: What does 'नमस्कार' (Namaskar) mean?
questions.explanation: 'नमस्कार' is the formal greeting in Marathi, equivalent to Hello or Greetings.

questions.question: What does 'मी' (Mi) mean in Marathi?
questions.explanation: 'मी' means I or Me in Marathi. Example: मी शाळेत जातो (I go to school).
